title: China Carbon ETS DID Pilot Fixture
abstract: This fixture follows the structure of a DID study of China's carbon emissions trading pilots and includes policy-timeline and identification evidence.

sections.policy background: China announced carbon emissions trading pilots in 2011 and implementation occurred across pilot regions in 2013 and 2014. The treatment timing section codes adoption by pilot launch year.
sections.parallel trends: The event-study pre-trend coefficients are near zero and support parallel trends for pilot and non-pilot provinces before treatment.
sections.no anticipation: The paper distinguishes announcement and implementation dates; no anticipation is supported because leads around the coded implementation date are null.
sections.treatment timing: Staggered adoption is handled with Sun-Abraham and Callaway-Sant'Anna estimators, and a Goodman-Bacon decomposition is reported.
sections.sutva: Potential carbon leakage and spatial spillover are discussed; adjacent provinces are excluded in a buffer robustness check.
sections.control group: A balance table compares pilot and non-pilot provinces, and matching checks support the donor pool.
sections.specification: Robustness tables vary province fixed effects, year fixed effects, controls, and functional form.
sections.inference: Standard errors are clustered by province, and wild-cluster bootstrap inference is reported as a robustness check.
sections.sample period: Sample period sensitivity checks vary the start period, end period, and treatment of unbalanced panels.
sections.concurrent policies: Concurrent environmental and industrial policies are enumerated, with policy controls and placebo periods used to isolate the carbon trading pilot.
sections.robustness placebo: Placebo-in-space, placebo-in-time, falsification tests, permutation checks, and randomization inference are reported.
sections.data measurement: The outcome data source documents definition stability, reporting changes, and missingness handling across provinces and years.
